notes:
Summary: Enterprise procurement for Private VPC deployment. Heavy emphasis on security/compliance for PHI. Legal + Security are converging on 3 major gates: DPA + SCCs, pen-test & remediation evidence, BYOK/HSM + audit logging.

Key requirements / asks (from Security & Legal):
- DPA with explicit PHI handling clauses; standard EU SCCs for any EU residency flows. Legal wants ability to review subprocessor list at contract signing.
- Pen test reports: require recent third-party pentest (last 12 months) + remediation plan. "Proof of remediation" for any critical findings before go-live.
- KMS integration: BYOK mandatory for any workload that touches PHI. HSM-backed keys preferred. Need key rotation policy and support for AWS KMS/custom HSM.
- Audit logging: full request/response metadata capture (token attribution redacted) and 90-day hot retention + 7-year archived logs for compliance. Must support push to their Splunk instance and RFC5424 syslog.
- Data residency: EU patient records must remain in eu-central-1. For hybrid workloads they want a clear routing/fallback policy (region pinning).
- SLA & liability: legal asked for minimum 99.95% availability for critical inference paths and clear RTO/RPO for on-prem fallbacks. Also require credits table in exhibit.
- Network: PrivateLink preferred; if VPC Peering used then must supply network diagram, IP ranges, and approved firewall rules. Egress constrained (must be able to block public internet egress for certain subnets).
- Auth: SSO via SAML+SCIM for user provisioning; SCIM for group sync; role mapping required (admin/ops/viewer).

Conversation snippets / notes from calls: 
- Security: "we cannot accept vendor-managed keys for PHI — BYOK or HSM only".
- Procurement: "send SCCs + DPA + the SOC2 Type II that covers hosted control plane".
- CTO: asked about latency numbers for 512-token seqs and can we guarantee <120ms p50 for chat-cached paths.

POC scope & success criteria (proposed):
- Deploy Private VPC in their AWS account (shared control plane with customer network restrictions).
- Integrate AWS KMS with BYOK flow; produce key usage logs exported to customer CloudTrail/Splunk.
- Demonstrate audit log export and SIEM ingestion; show 90-day hot access in Splunk.
- Execute a scoped pen-test (third-party) or deliver recent 3rd-party report + remediation evidence.
- Meet latency SLOs for demo traffic (p50 < 120ms, p95 < 450ms typical).

Procurement/legal path & timeline:
- 2025-03-28: Received DPA redline back. Key redlines: explicit PHI handling, BYOK as mandatory for PHI, 7-year retention for audit logs on request.
- Target: legal sign-off by 2025-04-10 to hit fiscal onboarding for Q3 usage.

Open items we must resolve before contract:
- Provide pen-test artifact and remediation sign-off (ticket SEC-8843).
- Provide signed SCCs + finalized DPA (procurement holds on SCC clause specifying subprocessors list cadence).
- Confirm HSM pricing and addendum for BYOK/HSM (pricing deck missing HSM line item).
- Detailed SLA exhibit with downtime credit table and operational contact.

Sales notes (AE):
- High priority, strong internal sponsor (CTO + Head of Security).
- Budget available but procurement is strict on contract terms due to PHI exposure.
- If legal accepts DPA + SCCs and we provide pen-test + BYOK/HSM terms, expect brownfield POC then production purchase (forecast 2025-06).

1) Send DPA + SCCs in redline-friendly format and highlight BYOK options and HSM pricing.
2) Attach SOC2 Type II and latest pen-test (or planned pen-test schedule + vendor name) to procurement email.
3) Schedule 60-minute workshop with infra sec to finalize network architecture (private link vs peering).
4) Prep SLA exhibit draft and send to legal for initial review.
